name: Adventure Bound Camping Resorts - Oak Creek
kind_of_no: mostly seasonal (under 1 site in 10 sold by the night)
why: Operator's Campspot-powered engine book.abcamping.com (park 65, read 2026-10-21) catalogues 282 RV sites but sells only ~10 by the night: dated searches (2 adults, 2-night weekday stays 2026-10-21, 10-27, 11-03 and 2027-03-23, 04-09, 04-20, 06-08, 07-13, 09-14) list just 9-10 bookable RV sites every time (2027: site 252 of the 84-site '30 Amp W/E/S' type plus 9 of the 168-site '30/50 Amp W/E/S' type: 233-236, 333-334, D-06..D-08), and its unavailability-days call shows the '30 Amp W/E' and all three Creek Side types (30 sites) closed to online booking every day of May 2026 - July 2027. ~10/282 = ~3.5%, below test 4's 1 in 10 (Sutter's 9% was skipped). Operator site pushes seasonal sales ('Seasonal Sites Available', $250 first-season discount, winter storage on site). Also: standing 2-night minimum (RESERVATION_MIN_RULE on every single weeknight tried), list weeknight rates $83-$107/night incl. Campspot fees with 25-50% weekday/spring deals; price gate would have been lifted (within 40 km of a family home, gateways.py).

name: Lakeside Campground
why: Fails long-stay test 4 (under 1 site in 10 sold by the night). campatlakeside.com/prices (read 2026-10-21): seasonal sites (lakefront $3,800, off-lake $3,000) and only two lettered nightly RV classes, 'ABCD Full Hookup' $55 and 'EFG Full Hookup' $65 (the same A-G scheme on every archived version since 2019), i.e. ~7 transient RV sites against the 95 full-hookup sites the home page states (~7%). Corroborated by RV Life reviews (Sep 2024: 'one of four full hook up sites near the...'; 'concrete pad rather than nearer the lake on gravel... Mostly seasonal campers'; Jul 2023 'Mostly seasonal campers but offered a pad') and RV Life's summary 'mostly seasonal, with a handful of transient sites'. Policies page: yearly rent due July 1, sheds/decks by approval, on-site trailer sales; Esri imagery at 42.2690,-79.7598 shows a trailer or park model on nearly every pad. Otherwise live: Google Maps 4.7 (164 reviews) with phone 716-736-3362, phone-only reservations, 3-night minimum only on holiday/event 'premium' weekends.
